claims: The 2026 Chicago River dyeing took place on Saturday, March 14, 2026, at 10 a.m.
The Chicago River dyeing is a St. Patrick's Day tradition since 1962.

The 2026 Chicago River dyeing uses about 40 pounds of an eco-friendly, vegetable-based powder, say NBC 5 Chicago and Block Club Chicago.
